subject: English
title: Tamil Nadu State Board English, Class II

source.read: SCERT Tamil Nadu, TNCF 2017 syllabus, English language, Standards 1 to 10 (published in the Tamil Nadu Government Gazette), read through a copy hosted by an exam-coaching site
source.note: UNOFFICIAL COPY OF AN OFFICIAL SOURCE. The state's own syllabus (TNCF 2017, marked draft), read through a text summary of a third-party copy of the gazette pages; the Standard 9 page was only partly readable. The Samacheer Kalvi textbooks follow it term by term.

licence: Strand names as printed (facts). Every outcome is written by OpenPath in its own words; no curriculum or textbook text is reproduced.
review: OpenPath curriculum inventory (AI-assisted research from secondary sources; not an educator review)

outcomes.note: Two-step tap instructions are practised by ear; spoken classroom instructions are not.

outcomes.text: Listens to stories, retells them and names the characters.
outcomes.note: Questions on a story heard are practised; retelling aloud is not heard.

outcomes.text: Hears blends, digraphs, long vowels and syllables.
outcomes.note: The Spelling Bee teaches sound-spelling patterns; listening for them on their own is not taught.

outcomes.text: Talks in two or three sentences about what was done or is being done.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Sings and recites, and uses polite expressions.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Reads one- and two-syllable words and sight words.
outcomes.note: The first reading level starts with short texts; decoding single words aloud is not heard.
Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Writes own name, parents' names and school address.
outcomes.note: Done with a grown-up, away from the app, who ticks what they saw.

Written here or on paper to a task set for this class. The learner checks it against a short list and a grown-up ticks what they see. The app does not keep or mark the writing; the essay studio gives a closer analysis where an evaluator is connected.

outcomes.text: Uses capital letters, full stops and question marks.
Uses the simple past (some irregular), past continuous and simple future.
Uses articles, pronouns and joining words.
Asks yes or no and wh- questions in the right word order.
Sorts words into groups and solves word puzzles.
outcomes.note: New words sorts words by meaning; jumbles and word searches are not in the app.
